title: Unethical
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.148 Numbered Discourses 3.148
  • 15. Maṅgalavagga 15. Good Fortune

Visamasutta Unethical

“Tīhi, bhikkhave …pe… “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there. … visamena kāyakammena, visamena vacīkammena, visamena manokammena—Unethical deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. … imehi kho …pe… evaṁ niraye.

Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi …pe… Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there. … samena kāyakammena, samena vacīkammena, samena manokammena—Ethical deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …” imehi kho …pe… evaṁ sagge”ti.

Tatiyaṁ.
